purpose: Zero-training post-hoc forensic of why frozen P29 underperformed P27 and did not restore native AUROC. This is not a new scientific train/predict/score attempt.

known_engineering_recovery.failure: R0 utility action computation was invoked under torch.no_grad(), producing RuntimeError: element 0 of tensors does not require grad and does not have a grad_fn
known_engineering_recovery.permitted_fix: Invoke the unchanged historical R0 utility only inside local torch.enable_grad(); cached P26 tensors remain detached and no optimizer is created or stepped.

sign_alignment.comparison: P29 sign agreement minus frozen P27 sign agreement

residual_magnitude.macro: P29 residual magnitude / P27 residual magnitude

source_gradient_probe.selection: For each held fold, select the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th alphabetical source classes after excluding that held class; use at most the first 8 deterministic cached source samples for each selected class.
states: the fold's frozen P29 adapter checkpoint
source_gradient_probe.p27_reference: g_P27_distill on the same cached source batch
zero_init: record exact autograd gradient norms for L_value, L_sign, and L_normal
classify L_sign and L_normal gradients as ZERO or NONZERO

normal_guard_conflict.mask: exact P29 pure-normal adaptive-max source mask: 518->37->9
metrics: teacher positive/zero/negative fractions in pure-normal regions

normality_score_shift.data: immutable held predictions plus post-hoc held GT only
normality_score_shift.execution: one vectorized pass per class; no pair matrix

segmentation_anchor_gradient.data: same deterministic source batches as source_gradient_probe
segmentation_anchor_gradient.loss: canonical P27 focal + normal Dice + abnormal Dice

output_recovery.comparison: also report frozen P27 recovery ratios

performance.preflight: one class, small cached subset, no scientific forensic output; measure seconds/sample, projected 12-class runtime, peak RAM/GPU, and I/O throughput
performance.memory_discipline: sequential memmap/shard access, one class at a time, bounded source batches

execution.exactly_one_attempt_marker: P29R1_FORENSIC_ATTEMPT.json immediately before first real forensic computation
execution.post_marker_policy: No code, protocol, or metric changes. A crash terminalizes P29R1_ENGINEERING_STOP unless exact continuation requires no modification.

primary_rules.gradient_starvation: P29 value gradient materially below P27 raw distillation, sign/normal near-zero at zero init, and residual suppression or weak sign improvement
primary_rules.segmentation_anchor_removal: g_seg meaningful and non-negative/aligned with teacher/value while P29 loses localization/breadth
primary_rules.normal_guard_conflict: meaningful positive teacher activity in pure-normal regions and/or g_normal conflicts
primary_rules.sign_fix_insufficient: sign improves materially but breadth worsens and pAUROC remains below P27/native
primary_rules.normality_fix_insufficient: normal q95/q99 inflation decreases yet AUROC remains poor
